name: Caramel Pudding Custard
description: Historical recipe from The Canadian Family Cook Book (1914). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

instructions.text: Put sugar and water into a mould and cook until sugar is of a dark color.
Allow it to run all over the mould.
Dip in cold water to set it.
Put into a saucepan with boiling water half way up the mould.
Cook about twenty minutes, cover mould with a buttered paper, and put cover on saucepan while the custard is steaming.

source.author: Grace E. Denison
source.originalInstructions:
1. Put sugar and water into a mould and cook until sugar is of a dark color.
2. Allow it to run all over the mould.
3. Dip in cold water to set it.
4. Pour in your custard.
5. Put into a saucepan with boiling water half way up the mould.
6. Cook about twenty minutes, cover mould with a buttered paper, and put cover on saucepan while the custard is steaming.
